feeAssumption: FULL TAKER on both legs of both lanes, recomputed from lib/funding-math's sourced per-venue taker table. Entry pays half the round trip; the exit half is charged ONLY if the position actually closes in-window.
model: Open ONCE on the first positive-funding appearance of each pair, HOLD, accrue real settled hourly funding (negative hours included, never floored), close ONLY when the position's realised trailing-24h funding decays to <=5% of its entry rate for 24h sustained. Otherwise still open at window end and reported as unrealised.

lanes.perp-spot: PRIMARY — long spot / short perp, same coin. Earns the perp's own funding; the spot hedge earns none. This is the raw persistent carry.
lanes.perp-perp: CONTROL — short the higher-funding venue / long the lower. Earns only the DIFFERENCE. Most venues quote the same default rate, so this lane is EXPECTED to be flat; a flat control means any primary edge is raw-vs-spot carry, not a cross-venue spread.

exitRules.funding_zeroed: |realised trailing-24h %/yr| <= 5% of entry gross %/yr, for 4 consecutive 6h judgements (24h sustained) → CLOSED, exit taker fee paid once.
exitRules.window_end_still_open: History ends before the funding zeroed → STILL OPEN, marked to window at funding minus ENTRY fee only, reported separately as unrealised. Never counted as realised profit.
exitRules.notExits: carry<=fees, drawdown and elapsed time are NOT exits in this model — that is the whole point of the test.

honesty.unknown: A held pair with no settled series on a needed venue is UNKNOWN → excluded from P&L and counted. Never assumed to be zero.
honesty.negativeFunding: Accrued as a real cost, never floored at zero, and reported separately as drag.
honesty.unrealised: Open-at-window-end P&L is reported in its own bucket and is NOT realised profit.
honesty.smallSample: A result carried by fewer than 5 independent positions is an anecdote, not evidence.
honesty.regime: ~13 days of history is ONE funding regime. Any positive result here is regime-specific and is NOT proof of a durable edge.
honesty.annualisation: All %/yr figures are run-rates extrapolated from ~13 days, not guarantees.

perp-spot.depthNote: This board persisted NO capacity/depth field, so sizing could NOT be depth-capped. Results assume the ticket always fills, which FLATTERS this lane.
perp-spot.takerFeeRecomputed: roundTripPerpSpotPct (perp taker×2 + spot taker×2); this board persisted no fee field

perp-perp.depthNote: Sized at min(ticket, greenCapacityUsd) — the REAL walked book depth. Never OI, never midpoint.
perp-perp.takerFeeRecomputed: roundTripFeeByVenue (taker×2 both legs); cross-checked against persisted totalFeesPct on 765290 rows, 0 differed

negativeFundingExposure.note: Negative hours are accrued as a real cost and never floored at zero. A held position PAYS when funding inverts.

capital.capitalConvention: Capital = 1× ticket per open position (one leg's notional; spot leg cash-funded, perp margin drawn from the same pool). If BOTH legs were funded separately the denominator doubles and every %/yr below HALVES.
capital.annualisationCaveat: Annualised from a ~13-day window: a run-rate, not guaranteed. Any figure above 200%/yr should be read as ">200%/yr run-rate, not guaranteed".
